The '''Relle Talisman''' was a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith talisman]] created by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] known as [[Zoiya Relle]]. Compensating for her lack of charisma and guile, Relle used the talisman to dominate the [[Brain/Legends|minds]] of other beings. The talisman later entered the possession of another [[Unidentified Sith (Relle Talisman)|Sith individual]] who [[Death/Legends|perished]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].<ref name="FaD" />
